mechanics.claim: The explosion deals the triggering attack's damage (the basic attack or Parrrley shot that destroyed the keg) to nearby enemies, not a fixed spell damage value.
mechanics.quote: it will explode to deal the {{as|attack's damage|pdamage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow}} them

mechanics.claim: Only an attack from Gangplank himself destroys and detonates the keg; an enemy destroying it simply dismantles it safely with no explosion.
mechanics.quote: If an enemy destroys a ''Powder Keg'', it is safely dismantled.

mechanics.claim: Bonus physical damage to champions and armor penetration only apply against champion targets, on top of the triggering attack's damage.
mechanics.quote: Against an enemy {{tip|champion}}, the explosion additionally deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and ignores a {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|portion of their armor}}}}.

mechanics.claim: A keg explosion can chain-trigger nearby connected kegs to also explode, each hitting an enemy once per chain.
mechanics.quote: The explosion will cause nearby ''Powder Kegs'' to also explode.

mechanics.claim: The triggering attack can critically strike, causing the explosion to deal the attack's critical damage instead.
mechanics.quote: The triggering attack on the keg can {{tip|critically strike}}, causing the explosion to deal the attack's critical damage.

mechanics.claim: The triggering attack's damage used for the explosion can include Parrrley's base damage and Spellblade, but on-hit proc damage against the keg itself is reduced to zero and does not add to the explosion.
mechanics.quote: Attacks against ''Powder Kegs'' will apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects (such as {{iis|Tiamat}} {{nie|Cleave}}), but {{tip|proc damage}} against the keg itself is reduced to 0.

mechanics.claim: Damage modifiers apply to damage dealt by kegs but not to damage dealt to kegs (i.e. the 1 damage per hit that reduces keg health).
mechanics.quote: [[Damage modifier]]s are applied to the damage dealt '''by''' kegs, but not to the damage dealt '''to''' kegs.

mechanics.claim: Slow, bonus champion damage, and keg health decay speed are locked in based on Gangplank's rank/level when the keg is placed, not when it explodes.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|slow}}, {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to champions, and keg {{as|health}} decay speed are determined when the keg is placed.
